sourceValue: The Grenada Tourism Authority lists Hangers as a planner of weddings and celebratory events and publishes its organizational email and phone.
Hangers’ official About page identifies Khaleen Johnson as founder and principal event planner.
Its destination package specifically offers guest-accommodation/group-rate assistance, guest transportation management and related social-event assistance.
Its full package advertises venue selection recommendations, vendor hiring/management, contract review and final-payment handling.
The homepage self-reports 100+ wedding events, 200+ decorated events and 300+ global clients; these are undated marketing totals, not independently audited production or hotel bookings.
The official resort wedding page states accommodation for up to 35 event guests and advertises full-service event staff, custom packages and catering.
The 2025 Radisson event listings demonstrate historical hotel-event use, not future demand at Spice Island.
